authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13161 saptāha period of seven days supports the pt-retaining Bengali/Hajong śopta week forms as learned Sanskrit vocabulary. Vowel rounding and the possible Bengali intermediary into Hajong are retained without requiring a settled intra-Indo-Aryan route. Exact survey form śopta is preserved.
